content.value_statement: Paid advertising teams need reusable audience definitions from CRM and analytics exports without exposing raw customer data. This skill turns owned data into seed audiences, lookalike seed lists, exclusions, and a funnel-stage map.
actual_capabilities: Profiles CRM, customer, ecommerce, or GA4 exports for audience-relevant columns.
Builds named seed audiences from traits, behavior, value, and purchase recency.
Ranks high-value customers into value-based lookalike seed lists.
Defines exclusion and suppression segments for customers, purchasers, and poor-fit records.
Maps audiences to cold, warm, hot, and customer funnel stages across platforms.
Creates a handoff summary for downstream campaign planning.
limitations: Requires user-provided exports or pasted column data.
Does not upload audiences through ad platform APIs.
Does not design campaign structure, ad groups, keywords, or creative.
Should store only aggregate segment descriptions, not raw PII rows.

use_cases.title: Create prospecting seeds
use_cases.description: Turn high-value customer exports into lookalike seed definitions for prospecting campaigns.

use_cases.title: Segment owned exports
use_cases.description: Group customer, ecommerce, or GA4 rows into reusable audience names and missing-input notes.

use_cases.title: Plan launch exclusions
use_cases.description: Define existing-customer, recent-purchaser, and poor-fit suppression segments before paid media launch.

prompt_templates.title: Basic segment plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Build audience segments from my CRM export at [path]. Goal: direct response. Platforms: Google and Meta.

prompt_templates.title: Lookalike seed ranking
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my customer export to create value-based lookalike seed lists. Rank by [value column] and exclude recent purchasers.

prompt_templates.title: Funnel stage map
prompt_templates.prompt: Map these GA4 audience exports to cold, warm, hot, and customer stages. Include retargeting windows and suppression rules.

prompt_templates.title: Cross-platform handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reusable audience handoff for Google, Meta, and LinkedIn. Include seed definitions, exclusions, missing inputs, and ROAS audience notes.

output_examples.input: CRM export with value, last purchase date, plan tier, and source columns.
output: Segment buckets: high-value repeat buyers, recent purchasers, inactive customers, and poor-fit refunds.
Lookalike seed: top value tier with aggregate size and value range.
Suppression: existing customers and purchasers within 30 days.

output_examples.input: GA4 audience and demographics export for Google and Meta planning.
output: Funnel map: cold interest audiences, warm site visitors, hot pricing-page visitors, and current customers.
Each stage includes retargeting windows, suppression notes, and platform-neutral names.

output_examples.input: Customer list missing fit score and last purchase date fields.
output: Available segments use value, tier, and source fields only.
Missing inputs are marked for fit score and purchase recency before final activation.

best_practices: Use owned exports with clear value, recency, and fit columns.
Hash or aggregate identifiers before sharing segment examples.
Confirm platform scope before naming reusable audiences.
anti_patterns: Do not upload raw customer rows in the final handoff.
Do not invent missing value, fit, or purchase columns.
Do not use this skill to choose campaign structure or keywords.

faq.question: What data does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs a CRM, customer, ecommerce, or GA4 export, plus the campaign goal and target platforms.

faq.question: Can it create lookalike audiences directly?
faq.answer: It creates the seed list definition. Platform expansion or upload is outside the core workflow.

faq.question: Does it handle PII?
faq.answer: It should work from hashed or aggregate descriptions. Final outputs should not include raw emails or phone numbers.

faq.question: Which platforms are supported?
faq.answer: It creates platform-neutral audience definitions for tools such as Google, Meta, and other paid media platforms.

faq.question: Does it build campaigns?
faq.answer: No. It prepares audience inputs for a campaign architecture skill or media planning workflow.

faq.question: What happens when columns are missing?
faq.answer: Missing fields become NEEDS_INPUT notes. The skill should not guess value, recency, or fit data.
